title: Look! You Can See the Feelings!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Twirly twirl! La la la!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: The red and pink colors are so pretty! It's like a butterfly! Or a flower!
choice_data_list: The kimono looks great on you.
The kimono looks great on you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I don't know much about patterns, so I said that I wanted one that was pretty!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And then this lovely outfit is what they gave me! I was so amazed!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Let's go somewhere right now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: A shrine! I wanna go to a shrine! Do you think any food stalls will be open?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We come to a shrine to find an assortment of food stalls open. Though not to the extent of New Year's, business looks to be doing well.

text_block_list.name: Man at the Shrine
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look! The kimono that girl's wearing looks kinda amazing!

text_block_list.name: Woman in Thick Clothing
text_block_list.text: You're right! It's so pretty and vibrant, like flowers!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you! Actually, it's—

text_block_list.name: Boy with His Mother
text_block_list.text: Mom, look! The clothes she's wearing are so cute!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text: That's called a kimono, honey. The bottom half is called a hakama—wait, is that a skirt? What a bold design!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Did you know? This is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every time Haru Urara opens her mouth to reply, the person she tries to talk to disappears, swept along by the moving crowd.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aww, they're gone! What a shame!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's go pray! I wanna show off my outfit to the gods as well!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hello gods! This is my new outfit! Don't I look super-duper cute?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep on doing my best wearing this, so please give me your blessings!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We take a short rest after having paid our respects. In the meantime, I ask Haru Urara what she tried to tell the passersby.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh! They all loved my outfit, remember? So I wanted to tell them all the great things about the kimono!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Like how the flowers are carefully drawn by an "artisan," or so I learned! Even all these tiny flowers!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I wanted to talk about the people who did all the cutting and string pulling. And also about this hair thingy and this dangly belt…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Haru Urara's word choice isn't very sophisticated, her enthusiasm and joy are conveyed loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She continues to explain all the details of her outfit to me with the brightest smile I've seen all day.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Everyone put in their most, best effort. And all for me too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Isn't it amazing? I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as she said, her outfit is indeed the product of many skilled craftspeople. Donning the fruit of their combined effort…
choice_data_list: You must be bursting with energy!
You must be bursting with energy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yep! Wearing this, I feel like I can do tons of things I normally can't!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Just like everyone who made this, I have to pour everything I got into training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She flashes me a smile so warm it seems to repel the wintry breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as she said, her outfit is indeed the product of many skilled craftspeople. Donning the fruit of their combined effort…
choice_data_list: It's like they'll always be there to support you.
It's like they'll always be there to support you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah… you're right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I asked for pretty clothing, but it turns out it's much more than just pretty!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: They'll always be with me, even when I'm running!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I won't ever be lonely while racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara lovingly touches her new outfit with a great big smile on her face.
